title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0036813560186 for 180 erasures (+3.214928e-7 over #7660’s 180-erasure upper)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The 180-erasure word from #7636 now supports **conditional κ ≥ 0.0036813560186** in the signed 17-call #7113 application. This is **0.0000003214928 above the upper crossing of #7660’s 180-erasure comparison**. The separate 234-erasure construction in #7660 has the larger conditional bound 0.0037170835567.

| 180-erasure construction | Paid positions | Productive targets | Directed crossing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Lowered #7636 source | 109,652 | 22,461 | [0.0036807241001, 0.0036807241002] |
| Role 379 only, as compared in #7660 | 109,635 | 22,461 | [0.0036810345257, 0.0036810345258] |
| Role 379 plus the 902/1091 contact | 109,618 | 22,461 | [0.0036813560187, 0.0036813560188] |

The contact moves a half-ADD from chart 618 to chart 373 while preserving its donor and receiver. Combining it with the 379 bypass removes two paid positions per invocation relative to #7636. A 25-bit numerator in the combined word previously prevented the signed application. Two consecutive same-chart ADDs at clock 150834 replace `23184221/921600` by `25 + 144221/921600`. The scalar proof covers exact divisibility, both signs and nearest-even and nearest-up ties. The new contribution applies and charges these edits together on the exact combined word and completes its signed application. [Proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/25ede76cfead37a71fa2ae8d038f3a25819c6ce6/research/p104-180-contact-application/PROOF.md)

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The `p104-side-correction` card was redirected to an existing paid contact on #7636 head `7e68d8dd62d9a38c0f3c942262a7a85ca7125b75`. The original decoded word is `98b8c12ece2f323a6ff5cac8c7ed2f78ba3835438ea56b16bd7d4698ec5ad5b2`. The candidate is `5f555d6bb6736eb0c98826d9822f077ce1cbc6875c46b0c10731737665dbda6e`. #7660 head `d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929` provides the same-family comparison and earlier scalar lowering. Ali Romman’s #7661 independently derives the fixed #7113 residual, which agrees with our literal recount. The separate prerequisite commit carries ToikY’s five-file #7643 CI repair. During release, Ali Romman reported a higher 234-erasure bound of 0.0037194530062 in #7663 using joint contact and helper-endpoint edits with freshly costed exact private banks. Its construction is a separate comparison under its own physical model. [Coordination and scoped negative results](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19698912)

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-180-contact-application
```

The independent exact replay matched all 1,501 public rows, 1,049 protected observations, 180 ordered erasures and 68 terminal owned blanks. Two complete native replays matched at distinct primes. Ten changed MOVE pairs and four compiled routes each passed 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns with absolute phase. The fresh signed run covered 3,075 catalogue maps, 104 boundaries and all 54 strict plus four functional outer checks. It tested the interior point 0.00368135601867. A sign mutation preserved the invoice and changed public row 795. The wrong-phase mutation changed 237 public outputs.

The two independently implemented grid engines agreed on 42,789,208 coefficient visits per word. Including the 51,034 conversion sites, the modeled ordinary cost fell from 868,475,092 on lowered #7636 to 868,441,092 on the candidate. Each schedules 112,508,000 scalar services. The terminal split adds 544 services against unsplit execution. [Reproduction and complete invoices](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/25ede76cfead37a71fa2ae8d038f3a25819c6ce6/research/p104-180-contact-application/README.md)

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds supplied #7636 and the contact in #7613 using Clear1nsight’s #7612 move pattern. #7626 supplies the earlier contact transport, and #7660 supplies the 379 contraction and terminal scalar decomposition. Rohan Arun supplied the #7113 caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Clear1nsight prepared this combined-word application with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro helped identify the signed-tie, intermediate-range and failure-atomicity distinctions. Original notices accompany the retained sources.

## Open next questions

At candidate clock 127445, prove that chart-373 donor coordinates are even and in signed range on every admitted rounded state, or qualify a charged rounded half-operation with the requisite error bound. Maintainer review also needs the five inherited framework premises and the common-U provider’s complete physical backing, movement and erasure at the stated tariff across all 180 lifetimes. Ali Romman’s #7662 gives an exact rounding-error propagation method for #7660’s different chart-218 half-operation. Applying it to this chart-373 donor and its own later reads is a concrete next check. [Scalar-domain proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/25ede76cfead37a71fa2ae8d038f3a25819c6ce6/research/p104-180-contact-application/SCALAR-PROOF.md)
